newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa rand, bonds end quiet day little changed.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa rand, bonds end quiet day little changed.

text.p: 1400 GMT - Rand ends lacklustre afternoon session little changed from Friday levels. Bonds a touch firmer after an equally dull day.

* Rand last at 4.4135/4165 on dollar from 4.4145/4175 on Friday. Dealers say rand spent much of day trying to find a range amid a dearth of market-moving news. Volumes on the day thin, although good two-way trade seen. Seen holding broad 4.40 to 4.4250 range again on Tuesday.

* Key R150 last at 14.715 pct from 14.735 pct on Friday after what dealers describe as a non-event day. Some concern about money mkt shortage holding above 10 bln rand, but bullish sentiment remains largely intact. Seen in 14.68 to 14.78 pct range for rest of week, with bias towards downside.
